g.title: MarieRank5Convo8 begins.
g.text: MarieRank5Convo8 begins.

g.title: j3650235455
g.text: How is it going with you and "the devil" lately?

g.title: j2222781278
g.text: [Confess Feelings] Marie? Can we talk?

g.title: j386906797
g.text: [Koniec]

g.title: j520518461
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j2209043138
g.text: Oui, qu'est-ce qu'il y a ?

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j4092896250
g.text: I fear I must call him "our" devil now, non ? For he is not leaving any time soon. Ha !

g.title: j520518461->j4092896250
g.text: RoatheFamilyDelay

g.title: j1181495316
g.text: I feel as though I should be asking you that question, non ? You are the one who is now cavorting with him !

g.title: j520518461->j1181495316
g.text: RoatheDating

g.title: j525608105
g.text: I do not know how you achieved what you did. But he has told us the truth of taking the serum.

g.title: j520518461->j525608105
g.text: RoatheRedeemed

g.title: j4138166858
g.text: I do not know how you achieved what you did. But he has told us the truth of taking the sérum.

g.title: j520518461->j4138166858
g.text: RoatheVillain

g.title: j3033431373
g.text: I worry for him. I think he hurts himself more than he lets on, n'est-ce pas?

g.title: j520518461->j3033431373
g.text: false

g.title: j3400011719
g.text: I'm sorry if this feels like it's coming out of nowhere, but I haven't known how to tell you earlier.

g.title: j4149877566
g.text: You have done well in getting his help with Monsieur Loid. I did not think it could be done.

g.title: j2286761238
g.text: I am resisting the tentation to ask you toutes sortes de commérages.

g.title: j326011510
g.text: Sol, to złamało mi serce. Jego głos nie załamał się, kiedy przemówił. Mais je l'ai vu dans ses yeux.

g.title: j2113306141
g.text: It breaks my heart. I hope his does not shatter in his chest some day. I do not know if he will survive it. I do not know if any of us will.

g.title: j2285781170
g.text: I adore you. I simply adore you.

g.title: j3724766806
g.text: There has been a change in him. Subtle, but it is there.

g.title: j2766050406
g.text: Well, I was wondering... if you'd like to, well... become a couple?

g.title: j4073729797
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2298753926
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j125207308
g.text: I za to jesteśmy ci wdzięczni.

g.title: j3373762513
g.text: Oh ! Oh, Drifter. I do not know how to say this, so I will just come right out with it, instead.

g.title: j2298753926->j3373762513
g.text: MarieNoDate

g.title: j2298753926->j3373762513
g.text: false

g.title: j1910882376
g.text: Och, czuję się tak samo ! Mais je ne sais pas comment te l'écrire, je n'ose pas taper les mots ! Uważałam się za głupca, że w ogóle o tym myślę !

g.title: j2298753926->j1910882376
g.text: MarieWillDate

g.title: j2681309019
g.text: Nie wiem, czy zawsze będzie tego chciał, ale zawsze może liczyć na swoich przyjaciół.

g.title: j617350017
g.text: Non.

g.title: j2237693223
g.text: Ach ! Jak bardzo mnie uradowałeś !

g.title: j3658164139
g.text: Though I think I will never tire of shouting at him !

g.title: j2127540642
g.text: If you are asking for a more... formal courtship, then oui ! Oui ! I would like this.

g.title: j1986464204
g.text: Mam wrażenie, że aż za bardzo polubił się z drażnieniem ciebie.

g.title: j3096966799
g.text: Cieszę się, że znaleźliście jakieś porozumienie.

g.title: j3000075799
g.text: Definitely not offering marriage, not yet.

g.title: j2522088169
g.text: Czasy z pewnością się zmieniły. Nie nazwałbym ich bardziej "formalnymi", ale z chęcią... wszystko ci pokażę.

g.title: j440062376
g.text: Comme un gros chat de gouttière. I have grown accustomed to him.

g.title: j3775522939
g.text: Oui ! As am I. He grows a little less insufferable every day.

g.title: j2993983090
g.text: Now I am the one teasing, do not worry. But, either way, je suis ravie ! And looking forward to learning these new... romantiques customs.

g.title: j1538127626
g.text: Hah ! I know when you are being wicked. Well. I look forward to it.

g.title: j4262190050
g.text: I think I would be sad if he were gone.

g.title: j339901489
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j523360200
g.text: Until then ? À la revoyure, mon cœur.

g.title: j1559150062
g.text: Boolean MarieDating is now true.

g.title: j264962945
g.text: Boolean IsDating is now true.

g.title: j3398976089
g.text: Boolean MarieHasDated is now true.
